title: Power and tone: Bunk, Oliver and Keppard
summary: Bunk's tone, whether Oliver and Freddie Keppard played powerfully, and their use or non-use of mutes.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends
